remarks: Updated tri-level "end unit" townhouse with garage. Freshly painted and new flooring just completed. This home has so much space- the main level has an oversized living room w/ deck + dining area, a large eat-in kitchen, and a half bath. The upper level features two large bedrooms, a full bath, two linen closets, and an attic. Finished lower level "rec room", laundry area, large storage area, and 1-car garage. Located within walking distance of Cummings Park, and a 3 minute drive to Cove Island Park! A wonderful opportunity awaits- all you need to do is unpack.
